name: workspace

scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck

//packageManager: Pins the pnpm that produced pnpm-lock.yaml. The lockfile records the `overrides` block from pnpm-workspace.yaml, which only pnpm 10+ reads — pnpm 9 looks for it in package.json instead, computes none, and fails the frozen-lockfile check. EAS Build picks its pnpm from this field, so without it a store build dies in `Install dependencies`.
